title: PVL: Galeries Tower's Erika Deloria earns Player of the Week nod
summary: Galeries Tower finally got over the hump in the 2026-27 PVL All-Filipino Conference Siklab Series on Tuesday, thanks in large part to the standout performance of Erika Deloria.
